dataset.title: Leicestershire and Rutland Invasive Non-Native Species

creator.organizationName: Leicestershire and Rutland Environmental Records Centre

metadataProvider.organizationName: Leicestershire and Rutland Environmental Records Centre

address.deliveryPoint: Unit F, 14 - 18 St Mary's Gate, Lace Market

abstract.para: This dataset contains all electronic records of Invasive Non-Native Species held by LRERC. It uses the INNS Species List provided by Natural England. It is collated from a number of sources. Last amended 01/03/2016

intellectualRights.para: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial (CC-BY-NC) 4.0 License.

geographicCoverage.geographicDescription: VC55 (Leicestershire and Rutland). Mainly at 100m resolution although only publically available at tetrad level.

purpose.para: Various, mainly casual records from ecological surveys. Collated to bring together INNS records in VC55.

description.para: All records are considerd to be at least 'Perfectly valid, no argument, species may not be of substantial importance tp warrant extensive validation processes'. The data is from LRERCs main database which is collated from a number of sources. LRERC holds additional attribute data on the records.

This is not a comprehensive dataset.
Data may not have been validated by the county recorder, but is considered valid using LRERCs validation policy.
Grid References have been checked using the NBN Record Cleaner to ensure that all records are within the county boundaries.

gbif.citation: Leicestershire and Rutland Environmental Records Centre (2017). Leicestershire and Rutland Invasive Non-Native Species. Occurrence dataset https://doi.org/10.15468/dommhp accessed via GBIF.org on 2022-02-16.
